content.title: Where to watch the Oklahoma City Thunder vs. Phoenix Suns Game 1 NBA playoffs for free
content.text: Oklahoma City Thunder guard Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (2) looks to pass the ball during the second half of an NBA basketball game against the Los Angeles Lakers, Tuesday, April 7, 2026, in Los Angeles.AP Photo/Caroline BrehmanIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Jenna Malinowski | JMalinowski@mlive.comThe Oklahoma City Thunder and the Phoenix Suns will begin their first-round Western Conference playoff series this afternoon.Fans can catch Game 1 from Oklahoma City at 3 p.m. ET on ABC, with streaming options available through Fubo, DirecTV Stream and ESPN Unlimited. New customers can score free trials and first-month discounts through Fubo and DirecTV Stream.Streaming OptionsFubo: Fans can catch the game with Fubo’s Pro plan, which offers 211 channels, including ABC, CBS, Fox, ESPN and more. New customers can start with a free trial of up to five days and score $25 off their first month. DirecTV Stream: DirecTV Stream’s Choice plan offers over 125 channels, including ABC, NBC, CBS, Fox and ESPN. New subscribers can start with a five-day free trial and take $35 off their first month. ESPN Unlimited: ESPN’s streaming service offers fans access to games on ESPN, ESPN2, ABC and more.
